'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are a forageable item found in most outdoor areas. It does not require any technologies to collect. After unlocking the Insects technology of the [[Farming and Nature (Tech Tree)|Farming and Nature tech tree]], collecting White Flowers may also yield [[butterfly|butterflies]] during the day or [[moth|moths]] at night.

==Alchemy==
{{PAGENAME}} is decomposable into [[Order solution|solution]] and [[Order extract|extract]] with the [[hand mixer]] and any of the distillation cubes, respectively. Having unlocked the [[Anatomy and Alchemy (Tech Tree)|Master of Alchemy]] produces one additional reagent at any workstation.
